record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase the fixed norm of nonpadding item embeddings from 1.0 to 1.1, retaining the single tied embedding table and 128 dimensions. Slightly stronger embedding magnitudes may improve GRU input sensitivity and attainable score separation while preserving shared context and candidate representations. Keep padding zero, history policy, GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update the predictor writer and metadata consistently.
